ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Heterogeneous distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels primarily on lateral lobes and 55% low-intensity (dark) pixels concentrated in the medial and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patches occupy the distal halves of both lobes; left lobe exhibits dense, irregular dark mottling; right lobe features a more uniform white field with distinct vertical dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; multiple macro-level jagged peaks (depth > 5 pixels) visible on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature observed on the superior edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups consistent with barnacle attachment sites concentrated along the distal tips and trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jaggedness along the trailing edge topography; dense white scarring clusters on the extreme lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of fine, parallel dark vertical striations located on the mid-section of the right lobe's ventral surface.
